items.title: New York Times: Grafström approved the plan
items.summary: The day before the World Cup final, five Fifa leaders got to see chairman Gianni Infantino's controversial business plan. Swedish Secretary General Mattias Grafström is said to have approved the proposal, but two other officials voted no, The New York Times reports.
items.title_original: New York Times: Grafström godkände planen
items.summary_original: Dagen före VM-finalen fick fem Fifa-toppar se ordförande Gianni Infantinos kontroversiella affärsplan. Den svenske generalsekreteraren Mattias Grafström ska ha godkänt förslaget, men två andra tjänstemän röstade nej, rapporterar The New York Times.

items.title: Here are the banks with the lowest variable interest rates
items.summary: Skandiabanken gave the lowest variable interest rate to its mortgage customers in July. Among the major banks, Nordea's variable average interest rate was the highest.
items.title_original: Här är bankerna med lägst rörlig ränta
items.summary_original: Skandiabanken gav lägst rörlig ränta till sina bolånekunder i juli. Bland storbankerna var Nordeas rörliga snittränta högst.

items.title: Tenant's storage room flooded after construction failure
items.summary: When Stockholm Water and Waste was renovating the water pipes in central Stockholm, a leak occurred in Vasastaden. Almost 40 basement storage rooms were flooded - a nightmare for many residents. - It is we who have been affected who will lose the most, says tenant Jenni Särlefalk.
items.summary_original: När Stockholm vatten och avfall renoverade vattenledningarna i centrala Stockholm uppstod en läcka i Vasastaden. Nästan 40 källarförråd blev översvämmade – en mardröm för många boende. – Det är vi som har drabbats som kommer att förlora mest, säger hyresgästen Jenni Särlefalk.

items.title: Minister for Foreign Affairs visits Latin America
items.summary: On 5–7 August, Minister for Foreign Affairs Maria Malmer Stenergard is visiting Brazil and Colombia. During the visit, Ms Malmer Stenergard is meeting with government representatives in the region and attending the presidential inauguration in Colombia.

items.title: Sweden strengthens Ukraine’s health and medical care through partnership and Swedish expertise
items.summary: Russia’s full-scale invasion has put Ukraine’s health and medical system under severe pressure at the same time as care needs have increased sharply. The Government is therefore allocating SEK 6.9 million to the Swecare Foundation for 2026 to strengthen Ukraine’s health care. This is being done through training initiatives, knowledge exchange and partnerships between Swedish and Ukrainian actors, including in the business sector.
